ALTER Procedure [dbo].[POL_Report_Instance_StudentSurvey_Detail_Pivot]
(
    @ScienceID          Nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @CourseID           Nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @TrainingLevelID    Nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @ClassID            Nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @YearID             Nvarchar(50) = Null,
    @Semester           Int = Null
)
As
Begin
    Set Nocount On;

    Create Table #tblAnswer
    (
        InstanceID          Int,
        TemplateID          Int,
        StudentID           Int,
        StudentCode         Nvarchar(50),
        StudentName         Nvarchar(200),
        ClassID             Nvarchar(50),
        ClassName           Nvarchar(200),
        CourseID            Nvarchar(50),
        CourseName          Nvarchar(200),
        ScienceID           Nvarchar(50),
        ScienceName         Nvarchar(200),
        SubjectID           Nvarchar(50),
        SubjectName         Nvarchar(500),
        TeacherID           Nvarchar(50),
        TeacherName         Nvarchar(200),
        Semester            Int,
        YearID              Nvarchar(50),
        CreatedDate         DateTime,
        IsSubmitted         Bit,
        QuestionOrderIndex  Int,
        AnswerValue         Decimal(10, 2),
        TextValue           Nvarchar(Max)
    );

    Insert Into #tblAnswer
    (
        InstanceID,
        TemplateID,
        StudentID,
        StudentCode,
        StudentName,
        ClassID,
        ClassName,
        CourseID,
        CourseName,
        ScienceID,
        ScienceName,
        SubjectID,
        SubjectName,
        TeacherID,
        TeacherName,
        Semester,
        YearID,
        CreatedDate,
        IsSubmitted,
        QuestionOrderIndex,
        AnswerValue,
        TextValue
    )
    Select
        POL_NEW_Instance.InstanceID,
        POL_NEW_Instance.TemplateID,
        POL_NEW_Instance.StudentID,
        SIM_Student.StudentCode,
        SIM_Student.StudentFirstName + ' ' + SIM_Student.StudentLastName,
        SIM_Class.ClassID,
        SIM_Class.ClassName,
        SIM_Course.CourseID,
        SIM_Course.CourseName,
        SIM_Science.ScienceID,
        SIM_Science.ScienceName,
        SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID,
        SIM_Subject.SubjectName,
        SIM_Teacher.TeacherID,
        SIM_Teacher.TeacherLastName + ' ' + SIM_Teacher.TeacherFirstName,
        POL_NEW_Instance.Semester,
        POL_NEW_Instance.YearID,
        POL_NEW_Instance.CreatedDate,
        POL_NEW_Instance.IsSubmitted,
        POL_NEW_Question.OrderIndex,
        POL_NEW_Answer.NumericValue,
        POL_NEW_Answer.TextValue
    From POL_NEW_Answer
    Inner Join POL_NEW_Instance
        On POL_NEW_Answer.InstanceID = POL_NEW_Instance.InstanceID
    Inner Join POL_NEW_Question
        On POL_NEW_Answer.QuestionID = POL_NEW_Question.QuestionID
    Inner Join SIM_Student
        On POL_NEW_Instance.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
    Inner Join SIM_Class_Subject
        On POL_NEW_Instance.ClassSubjectID = SIM_Class_Subject.ClassSubjectID
    Inner Join SIM_Subject
        On SIM_Class_Subject.SubjectID = SIM_Subject.SubjectID
    Inner Join SIM_Class
        On SIM_Class_Subject.ClassID = SIM_Class.ClassID
    Inner Join SIM_Course
        On SIM_Class.CourseID = SIM_Course.CourseID
    Inner Join SIM_Science
        On SIM_Class.ScienceID = SIM_Science.ScienceID
    Left Join SIM_Teacher
        On SIM_Class_Subject.TeachingBy = SIM_Teacher.TeacherID
    Where
        (
            POL_NEW_Instance.TemplateID In (1, 2)
        )
        And
        (
            @ScienceID Is Null
            Or Cast(SIM_Science.ScienceID As Nvarchar(50)) = @ScienceID
        )
        And
        (
            @CourseID Is Null
            Or Cast(SIM_Course.CourseID As Nvarchar(50)) = @CourseID
        )
        And
        (
            @ClassID Is Null
            Or Cast(SIM_Class.ClassID As Nvarchar(50)) = @ClassID
        )
        And
        (
            @YearID Is Null
            Or Cast(POL_NEW_Instance.YearID As Nvarchar(50)) = @YearID
        )
        And
        (
            @Semester Is Null
            Or POL_NEW_Instance.Semester = @Semester
        )
        And
        (
            @TrainingLevelID Is Null
            Or Cast(SIM_Class.TrainingLevelID As Nvarchar(50)) = @TrainingLevelID
        );

    Declare @PivotCols Nvarchar(Max);
    Declare @Sql Nvarchar(Max);

    Select
        @PivotCols = Stuff
        (
            (
                Select
                    ', Max(Case When QuestionOrderIndex = ' + Cast(q.QuestionOrderIndex As Nvarchar(10))
                    + ' Then AnswerValue End) As [Cau' + Cast(q.QuestionOrderIndex As Nvarchar(10)) + ']'
                From
                (
                    Select Distinct QuestionOrderIndex
                    From #tblAnswer
                    Where QuestionOrderIndex Is Not Null
                ) q
                Order By q.QuestionOrderIndex
                For Xml Path(''), Type
            ).value('.', 'Nvarchar(Max)'),
            1,
            1,
            ''
        );

    If @PivotCols Is Null Or @PivotCols = ''
    Begin
        Select Distinct
            InstanceID,
            TemplateID,
            StudentID,
            StudentCode,
            StudentName,
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            SubjectID,
            SubjectName,
            TeacherID,
            TeacherName,
            Semester,
            YearID,
            CreatedDate,
            IsSubmitted
        From #tblAnswer
        Order By
            CourseName,
            ScienceName,
            ClassName,
            SubjectName,
            StudentName;

        Drop Table #tblAnswer;
        Return;
    End;

    Set @Sql = N'
    Select
        InstanceID,
        TemplateID,
        StudentID,
        StudentCode,
        StudentName,
        ClassID,
        ClassName,
        CourseID,
        CourseName,
        ScienceID,
        ScienceName,
        SubjectID,
        SubjectName,
        TeacherID,
        TeacherName,
        Semester,
        YearID,
        CreatedDate,
        IsSubmitted,
        Max(TextValue) As YKien,
        ' + @PivotCols + '
    From #tblAnswer
    Group By
        InstanceID,
        TemplateID,
        StudentID,
        StudentCode,
        StudentName,
        ClassID,
        ClassName,
        CourseID,
        CourseName,
        ScienceID,
        ScienceName,
        SubjectID,
        SubjectName,
        TeacherID,
        TeacherName,
        Semester,
        YearID,
        CreatedDate,
        IsSubmitted
    Order By
        CourseName,
        ScienceName,
        ClassName,
        SubjectName,
        StudentName';

    Exec sp_executesql @Sql;

    Drop Table #tblAnswer;
End

    Inner Join POL_NEW_Instance

    Inner Join POL_NEW_Question

    Where

        And

            TemplateID,
            StudentID,
            StudentCode,
            StudentName,
            ClassID,
            ClassName,
            CourseID,
            CourseName,
            ScienceID,
            ScienceName,
            SubjectID,
            SubjectName,
            TeacherID,
            TeacherName,

            CreatedDate,
            IsSubmitted

        Order By
            CourseName,
            ScienceName,
            ClassName,
            SubjectName,
            StudentName;

        Drop Table #tblAnswer;
        Return;
    End;

    Set @Sql = N'
    Select
        InstanceID,
        TemplateID,
        StudentID,
        StudentCode,
        StudentName,
        ClassID,
        ClassName,
        CourseID,
        CourseName,
        ScienceID,
        ScienceName,
        SubjectID,
        SubjectName,
        TeacherID,

        ScienceName,

        Semester,
        YearID,
        CreatedDate,
        IsSubmitted
    Order By
        CourseName,
        ScienceName,
        ClassName,
        SubjectName,
        StudentName';

    Exec sp_executesql @Sql;

    Drop Table #tblQuestion;
    Drop Table #tblAnswer;
End

## Nguyên nhân

Store cũ pivot theo **`OrderIndex`**:


- Hoặc **NULL** ở hầu hết câu, chỉ 1 câu có `OrderIndex = 2`
